# TC.ModemMessage

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.ModemMessage"></a>

### TC.ModemMessage

This event delivers an accepted radar datagram through a modem_message registration.
Numeric channels are distinct from wire colors.
A dual-color receiver gets one event per registration/receiver.
Authorized wires are in red-before-green order. Each delivery has isolated data.

Radio does not expose remote peripherals or sender authority.
There is no ACK, automatic reply, retry, retained mailbox or guaranteed reception.

Extends: TC.BaseEvent

### channel

Received numeric channel, 0..65535.

```text
integer
```

### distance (optional)

Euclidean distance in tiles on one surface. This field is absent across surfaces.

```text
number
```

### message (optional)

Copied message. This field is absent for explicit top-level nil.

```text
TC.Data
```

### name

Radio event discriminator.

```text
'modem_message'
```

### peripheral

Local receiving modem, not the sender.

```text
TC.PeripheralName
```

### replyChannel

Sender-specified numeric reply channel, 0..65535.

```text
integer
```

### sent_tick

Simulation tick of transmission acceptance.

```text
TC.Tick
```

### wire

First authorized receiver discovery color.

```text
TC.Wire
```

### wires

Receiver discovery colors in red-before-green order at acceptance.

```text
(TC.Wire)[]
```
